mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM CHALLENGE c
JOIN CHALLENGE_RESULT r ON r.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE

SELECT c.CODE AS code, c.TITLE AS title, c.CONTENT AS content,
c.START_DATE AS startDate, c.END_DATE AS endDate, c.CREATED_AT AS createdAt,
a.EMP_ID AS adminId, a.ROLE AS adminRole,
( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = c.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'challenge' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnail,
r.PARTICIPANT_COUNT AS participantCount,
r.AVERAGE_ACHIEVEMENT_RATE AS averageAchievementRate,
NULL AS rewardPaid
FROM CHALLENGE c
JOIN CHALLENGE_RESULT r ON r.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE
LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ACCOUNT a ON a.CODE = c.ADM_CODE
ORDER BY r.PARTICIPANT_COUNT DESC, c.CODE DESC
ORDER BY r.PARTICIPANT_COUNT ASC, c.CODE DESC
ORDER BY r.AVERAGE_ACHIEVEMENT_RATE DESC, c.CODE DESC
ORDER BY r.AVERAGE_ACHIEVEMENT_RATE ASC, c.CODE DESC
ORDER BY c.END_DATE DESC, c.CODE DESC
LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.CODE AS code, c.TITLE AS title, c.CONTENT AS content,
c.TITLE AS categoryName,
c.GOAL AS goal, c.START_DATE AS startDate, c.END_DATE AS endDate, c.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, c.PROGRESS_STATUS AS progressStatus,
c.POINT_EARNED AS pointEarned, c.MAX_PARTICIPANTS AS maxParticipants,
a.EMP_ID AS adminId, a.ROLE AS adminRole,
( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = c.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'challenge' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnail,
NULL AS totalPaidPoints, NULL AS rewardPaid
FROM CHALLENGE c
JOIN CHALLENGE_RESULT r ON r.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE AND r.STATUS = 'COMPLETED'
LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ACCOUNT a ON a.CODE = c.ADM_CODE
WHERE c.CODE = #{code} AND c.DELETE_YN = 0 AND c.PROGRESS_STATUS = 'ENDED'

SELECT r.CODE, r.CHAL_CODE, r.PROOF_COUNT, r.PARTICIPANT_COUNT, r.AVERAGE_LIKE_COUNT, r.AVERAGE_ACHIEVEMENT_RATE, r.SUCCESS_RATE, r.MEMBER_RESULTS_JSON, r.HOURLY_RESULTS_JSON, r.REGION_RESULTS_JSON, r.ENDED_AT, r.SAVED_AT, r.STATUS
FROM CHALLENGE_RESULT r
JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.CODE = r.CHAL_CODE
WHERE r.CHAL_CODE = #{code} AND r.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND c.DELETE_YN = 0 AND c.PROGRESS_STATUS = 'ENDED'
